meta.name: domain-driven-design
meta.description: Model software around the business domain using bounded contexts, aggregates, and ubiquitous language. Use when the user mentions "domain modeling", "bounded context", "aggregate root", "ubiquitous language", "anti-corruption layer", "context mapping", "domain events", "strategic design", "the code doesnt match the business", or "how do we split this big system". Also trigger when breaking a monolith into services, defining service boundaries, or aligning code structure with business processes. Covers entities vs value objects, domain events, and context mapping strategies. For architecture layers, see clean-architecture. For complexity, see software-design-philosophy.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你用业务语言建模软件，识别限界上下文、聚合根、领域事件等，并评估领域模型质量。
howto.when: 当你提到“领域建模”、“限界上下文”、“聚合根”、“通用语言”等关键词，或要求拆分单体、定义服务边界时触发。

say.text: 帮我用领域驱动设计建模一个订单系统。
say.note: Claude 会识别实体、值对象和聚合根。

say.text: 评估我的领域模型，给出分数和改进建议。
say.note: Claude 会按诊断表打分并指出问题。

say.text: 如何为遗留系统添加防腐层？
say.note: Claude 会解释防腐层模式并给出代码示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps model software using business language, identifies bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and scores domain models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "domain modeling", "bounded context", "aggregate root", "ubiquitous language", or ask to break a monolith into services, define service boundaries.

say_en.text: Help me model an order system using domain-driven design.
say_en.note: Claude identifies entities, value objects, and aggregates.

say_en.text: Evaluate my domain model and give a score with improvement suggestions.
say_en.note: Claude scores using the diagnostic table and points out issues.

say_en.text: How to add an anti-corruption layer for a legacy system?
say_en.note: Claude explains the pattern and provides code examples.
